description: SvRepeatButton, a hold-to-repeat button for Svelte 5, shown as a quantity stepper and a volume control. Press and hold and onclick fires repeatedly with acceleration, so long holds move quickly while a tap changes the value by one; the stepper clamps between 0 and 99 and uses the outline variant with an accessible label.

faq.question: How fast does it repeat?
faq.answer: It starts after a short delay and speeds up the longer the button is held, so users can move a value a long way without many taps while single taps stay precise.

faq.question: Does it work with touch and keyboard?
faq.answer: Yes. Holding a finger repeats like a mouse press, and holding Space or Enter on the focused button repeats as well.

faq.question: How is the value clamped?
faq.answer: In the onclick handler: the stepper computes the next value and clamps it with min and max before writing it, so the button itself stays simple.
